invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> object, so result cannot be null under normal execution.
The preppedRecords argument is passed into another method; it is likely required to be non-null for execution.
The instantTime parameter is required to identify the action's timeframe and is passed directly into the executor, so it must be non-null.
context is cast and used immediately and thus must be non-null to avoid NullPointerException.
